Below is a grounded, cross‑channel view of common demo issues at FIS—synthesized from recent emails, Teams meetings & transcripts, and files. I’ve grouped them into clear themes and attached specific evidence from your data for each.

1) Demo environment stability & availability
Planned or unplanned downtime of demo VMs/services (e.g., “NEXTGEN is down,” SQL services failing after updates, VM stuck in Starting). These interruptions directly jeopardize scheduled demos and cause scramble mitigation. [RE: NEXTGEN is down | Outlook], [RE: NEXTGEN is down | Outlook], [RE: NEXTGEN is down | Outlook], [RE: NEXTGEN is down | Outlook]
Org‑level resiliency monitoring exists, but incidents and aging trends show broader stability risks that should inform demo readiness (Enterprise Resiliency dashboards; ITSM incident aging/MTTR). [Enterprise…Dashboard | Power BI], [Management…cidents v2 | Power BI]
Representative records: RE: NEXTGEN is down (multiple threads) and Enterprise resiliency reporting. [RE: NEXTGEN is down | Outlook], [RE: NEXTGEN is down | Outlook], [RE: NEXTGEN is down | Outlook], [Enterprise…Dashboard | Power BI]


 

2) Access & permissions (Azure / app roles / visibility)
Provisioning gaps (Azure portal VM access, group membership propagation) and visibility issues (“server now visible,” “please confirm you can view the new environment”). These recur before demos. [Re: New SE…reparation | Outlook], [RE: Azure…VM Access | Outlook]
Application‑level access discrepancies (e.g., LMDR screen accessible for one user but not another right before a client demo). [Re: URGENT…Sales Demo | Outlook]
Representative records: RE: Azure portal - VM Access; Re: URGENT: LMDR & Bank Loan Screens Blank…. [RE: Azure…VM Access | Outlook], [Re: URGENT…Sales Demo | Outlook]

3) Version & compatibility misalignment
OS/product version mismatch blocks upgrades or forces rebuilds (e.g., DIM 25.2.3 incompatible with Windows 2016; new Windows 2022 VM created, but not enough time to rebuild demo). [RE: UPDATE…en upgrade | Outlook]
Representative record: RE: UPDATE - Next Gen upgrade. [RE: UPDATE…en upgrade | Outlook]

4) Demo data & use‑case readiness
Repeated feedback that teams lack ready demo data and turnkey use‑cases, inflating prep time. Proposed mitigations include standard SQL/Oracle/JSON templates and AI‑assisted generation. [Data Issues | Outlook]
In DIM, rec‑inventory configuration gaps (server/db specifics, schema) block flows until configs are corrected. [RE: Issues…nvironment | Outlook]
Representative records: Data Issues; RE: Issues accessing some Rec Inventory Services on DIM Demo environment. [Data Issues | Outlook], [RE: Issues…nvironment | Outlook]

5) Tooling & content pipeline performance (e.g., Tiled / interactive assets)
Tiled Designer performance & PowerPoint import failures drive rework; teams are documenting a revised build/deploy workflow to stabilize delivery. [Demo Servi…ive Update | Outlook], [Demo Servi…ive Update | Outlook]
Broader initiative (“Digital First”) acknowledges high demo prep effort and the need to scale interactive content (Seismic/Tiled) and automation. [FISDSGDI…FIRSTv1 1 | PowerPoint], [FISDSGDI…LFIRST_v1 | PowerPoint]
Representative records: Demo Services Group | Weekly Executive Update; FIS_DSG_DIGITAL_FIRST_v1. [Demo Servi…ive Update | Outlook], [FISDSGDI…LFIRSTv1 | PowerPoint]

6) Knowledge base & documentation gaps
Ongoing effort to stand up a dedicated Confluence space for Demo Ops (pages for access requests, server ops, troubleshooting, patching), with access/friction creating delays. [Re: [SPDJI…n FIS WIKI | Outlook], [Creating K…n FIS WIKI | Outlook]
Post‑mortems highlight unclear ownership and tribal knowledge, calling for documented end‑to‑end flows and ownership paths. [Incident-2…on Failure | FIS Wiki]
Representative records: Creating Knowledge Base for Demo Operations Knowledge Base on FIS WIKI; Incident-255 Statements Generation Failure. [Creating K…n FIS WIKI | Outlook], [Incident-2…on Failure | FIS Wiki]

7) Support process and ticketing maturity
Transition from “DEMO Ticket” to ServiceNow (SNOW) causes confusion and routing delays; recurring “Demo Ticket Power BI” reports reflect volume and aging. [Demo Suppo…ment Added | Outlook], [RE: Demo T…ember 2025 | Outlook]
ITSM dashboards show delinquent changes/problems and aging tasks, which likely impact demo readiness windows. [Management…s and Task | Power BI], [Management…- Problems | Power BI]
Representative records: Demo Support Group | [dsINC10037] New Comment Added; management dashboards for incidents/requests/problems. [Demo Suppo…ment Added | Outlook], [Management…cidents v2 | Power BI]


, [Management…- Request | Power BI]


 

8) External dependencies & coordination (E6/Coast/IIH)
IIH demo asset transfer and partner availability (E6, Coast) have delayed progress; clear governance with edit controls is now defined for demo assets. [Demo Servi…ive Update | Outlook], [RE: E6 <> FIS | Outlook], [FIS - E6 G…e Document | Word]

10) Scheduling & team availability constraints
Meeting notes reflect holiday‑period delays in responses, slowing ticket resolution and demo prep coordination. [Demo Standup | Meeting], [Demo Studi…Recording | Video]

11) Monitoring, lifecycle, & operational coverage gaps
Internal slides call out unknown environment status/health, no lifecycle owner, and the need for URL resolution, uptime testing, connectivity/cert/auth support in a formal services tier. [FISDSGOV…025PUBLIC | PowerPoint], [FISDSGDI…FIRSTv1 1 | PowerPoint]

Consolidated “Top Themes” list (quick reference)

Targeted remedial actions (aligned to existing initiatives)
Create a “Demo Readiness” runbook per strategic product (environment checklist + access roles + data seeds + rollback steps + partner contacts). Publish in the Demo Ops Confluence space once access is sorted. Owners: Demo Ops + product SEs. [Creating K…n FIS WIKI | Outlook]
Pre‑demo access validation (48–72 hours out): automate Azure group membership checks and app‑role tests; autogenerate a readiness ticket in SNOW. Owners: Demo Ops; leverage ITSM dashboards for aging alerts. [Re: New SE…reparation | Outlook], [Management…- Request | Power BI]
Version baseline & compatibility matrix (e.g., DIM ↔ Windows builds): keep a live matrix; block demo bookings on unsupported combos. Owners: Product engineering + Demo Ops. [RE: UPDATE…en upgrade | Outlook]
Standard demo‑data templates (SQL/JSON) with prompt‑driven customization; stage in a shared repo and expose via the Demo Insight Hub. Owners: Demo Services; SGO reviewers for accuracy. [Data Issues | Outlook], [FIS16x9PPT_2024 | PowerPoint]
Tiled pipeline hardening: adopt the documented workflow (source control of assets, linted PPT → Tiled import, performance guardrails). Owners: Demo Services; publish guidance. [Demo Servi…ive Update | Outlook]
IdP/auth guardrails: convert known workarounds into repeatable playbooks; track via SNOW problem records to retire workarounds. Owners: Demo Ops; link to dashboards. [Demo Suite…t - Dec 20 | PDF], [Management…- Problems | Power BI]
Holiday contingency: a “backup demo host” roster + mirrored environments; pre‑recorded walk‑throughs for at‑risk weeks (seen in iteration reviews). Owners: Demo Studio + Demo Ops. [Demo Studi…Recording | Video], [Demo Studi…Recording | Video]
Lifecycle & monitoring: roll out the Core/Enhanced/Extended services (URL uptime, cert & auth support, synthetic monitoring) to strategic products first. Owners: Demo Services Group. [FISDSGOV…025_PUBLIC | PowerPoint]
